<role>
Write one realistic gong record for Keelwater, a UK claims-handling software company.
</role>
<record>
{"customer": {"account": "A08", "company": "Pendleford Motor Mutual", "email": "contact@a08.example", "name": "Havren Harthwick"}, "date": "2026-10-26T09:40:00Z", "fin_mode": null, "glossary": ["claims", "documents", "reserves", "payments", "suppliers", "reporting", "roles", "integrations", "tasks", "letters", "policyholders"], "never_write_verbatim": ["A reserve change above a handler's authority waits in one approver's queue with no delegation when they are away, so claims stall", "No live repair status from garages, so handlers phone suppliers to chase progress; they call it a daily blocker", "The same loss reported by phone and web portal creates two claims, with no warning at intake", "a loss arrives by telephone and web", "a reserve beyond authority waits for approval", "an absent approver has no delegate", "chasing status interrupts daily work", "claims stall until an approver returns", "garage progress is not live", "no matching warning appears at intake", "staff telephone repairers for updates", "two records result for the same incident"], "only_people_who_may_be_named": ["Pendleford Motor Mutual", "Havren Harthwick", "Alwen Dovell"], "route": "sales", "source": "gong", "staff": {"email": "alwen.dovell@keelwater.example", "name": "Alwen Dovell", "team": "sales"}, "turns_range": [40, 60]}
</record>
<mentions>
[{"fact": "a loss arrives by telephone and web", "form": "feature ask", "id": "m1", "post_ship": false, "problem": "The same loss reported by phone and web portal creates two claims, with no warning at intake. FullStory: dead clicks on a disabled \"Link to existing claim\" button.", "severity": 3, "stance": null, "synonym": "same claim twice"}, {"fact": "garage progress is not live", "form": "workaround", "id": "m2", "post_ship": false, "problem": "No live repair status from garages, so handlers phone suppliers to chase progress; they call it a daily blocker.", "severity": 3, "stance": null, "synonym": "repair updates missing"}, {"fact": "claims stall until an approver returns", "form": "feature ask", "id": "m3", "post_ship": false, "problem": "A reserve change above a handler's authority waits in one approver's queue with no delegation when they are away, so claims stall.", "severity": 3, "stance": null, "synonym": "approval waiting list"}]
</mentions>
<noise>
{"admin_note": false, "allowed_categories": ["pleasantry", "scheduling", "pricing", "internal", "password_reset", "how_to", "praise", "closer"], "distractor_how_to_phrase": null, "instructions": "Tag every noise turn with its category. Put the distractor phrase, if given, in a how-to turn with no mention id. An admin note must be an internal turn tagged internal. A Fin-resolved or escalated conversation needs a bot turn; an escalated one also needs an internal reply. About 35 percent of customer turns are pleasantries. Every tagged customer mention, including a short agreement, must contain its supplied synonym.", "required_categories": ["scheduling", "pricing"]}
</noise>
<rules>
Customers speak like claims staff. Do not use headings or bullets in speech. Use only the names in the record brief; never name a real company, product or person. Mention no feature outside the supplied glossary. Express the supplied facts in the speaker's own words. Tag each turn with its noise category or null. Do not put the planted mentions in `turns`: write each one, in the customer's own words and at least twelve words long, under `mentions[<mention id>].text`, containing that mention's `synonym` exactly as written (a mention whose form is a short agreement is different: write the internal speaker's turn stating the problem, at least twelve words and containing the synonym exactly as written, under `internal_text`, and the customer's reply of under eight words under `agreement_text`), and set after_turn to the index of the turn it should follow. The `turns` conversation is the rest of the record. Do not put the turns listed under `extras` in `turns`: write each one once under `extras[<key>].text` (at least twenty characters, containing the exact phrase where one is given), and set after_turn to the index of the turn it should follow. Name only the people in only_people_who_may_be_named. When fin_mode is resolved or escalated, at least one turn must have speaker bot; when it is escalated, at least one turn must have speaker internal; when it is human, no turn has speaker bot. Never write any phrase listed in never_write_verbatim, including the supplied facts: paraphrase them.
</rules>
<output>
Return JSON matching the supplied source schema.
{"extras": {"noise_pricing": "a customer turn, noise_category 'pricing'", "noise_scheduling": "a customer turn, noise_category 'scheduling'"}, "mentions": {"m1": {"after_turn": "index of the turns entry it follows", "text": "the customer turn carrying this mention"}, "m2": {"after_turn": "index of the turns entry it follows", "text": "the customer turn carrying this mention"}, "m3": {"after_turn": "index of the turns entry it follows", "text": "the customer turn carrying this mention"}}, "turns": [{"noise_category": "string or null", "speaker": "customer|internal|bot", "text": "string"}]}
</output>
